uri.label: URI
uri.hint: The full URI to make HTTP requests to.

decoding.codec.label: Decoding Codec
decoding.codec.hint: The codec to use for decoding events.

tls.enabled.label: TLS Enabled
tls.enabled.hint: Whether or not to require TLS for incoming or outgoing connections. When enabled and used for incoming connections, an identity certificate is also required. See tls.crt_file for more information.

tls.alpn_protocols.label: ALPN protocols
tls.alpn_protocols.hint: Sets the list of supported ALPN protocols. Declare the supported ALPN protocols, which are used during negotiation with peer. They are prioritized in the order that they are defined.

tls.ca_file.label: Certificate Authority File
tls.ca_file.hint: Absolute path to an additional CA certificate file.

tls.crt_file.label: Certificate File
tls.crt_file.hint: Absolute path to a certificate file used to identify this server.

tls.key_file.label: Private Key
tls.key_file.hint: Absolute path to a private key file used to identify this server.

tls.key_pass.label: Private Key Passphrase
tls.key_pass.hint: Passphrase used to unlock the encrypted key file.

tls.server_name.label: Server Name
tls.server_name.hint: Server name to use when using Server Name Indication (SNI).

tls.verify_certificate.label: Verify Certificate
tls.verify_certificate.hint: Enables certificate verification. For components that create a server, this requires that the client connections have a valid client certificate. For components that initiate requests, this validates that the upstream has a valid certificate.

tls.verify_hostname.label: Verify Hostname
tls.verify_hostname.hint: Enables hostname verification. If enabled, the hostname used to connect to the remote host must be present in the TLS certificate presented by the remote host, either as the Common Name or as an entry in the Subject Alternative Name extension. Only relevant for outgoing connections.

acknowledgements.enabled.label: Acknowledgements Enabled
acknowledgements.enabled.hint: Whether or not end-to-end acknowledgements are enabled.

batch.max_bytes.label: Batch Max Bytes
batch.max_bytes.hint: The maximum size of a batch that is processed by a sink.

batch.max_events.label: Batch Max Events
batch.max_events.hint: The maximum size of a batch before it is flushed.

batch.timeout_secs.label: Batch Timeout Secs
batch.timeout_secs.hint: The maximum age of a batch before it is flushed.

buffer.type.label: Buffer Type
buffer.type.hint: The type of buffer to use.

buffer.max_events.label: Buffer Max Events
buffer.max_events.hint: The maximum number of events allowed in the buffer.

buffer.max_size.label: Buffer Max Size
buffer.max_size.hint: The maximum size of the buffer on disk. Must be at least ~256 megabytes (268435488 bytes).

buffer.when_full.label: Buffer When Full
buffer.when_full.hint: Event handling behavior when a buffer is full.

encoding.csv.capacity.label: Encoding CSV Capacity
encoding.csv.capacity.hint: Set the capacity (in bytes) of the internal buffer used in the CSV writer. This defaults to a reasonable setting.

encoding.csv.delimiter.label: Encoding CSV Delimiter
encoding.csv.delimiter.hint: The field delimiter to use when writing CSV.

encoding.csv.double_quote.label: Encoding CSV Double Quote
encoding.csv.double_quote.hint: Enable double quote escapes. This is enabled by default, but it may be disabled. When disabled, quotes in field data are escaped instead of doubled.

encoding.csv.escape.label: Encoding CSV Escape
encoding.csv.escape.hint: The escape character to use when writing CSV.

encoding.csv.fields.label: Encoding CSV Fields
encoding.csv.fields.hint: Configures the fields that will be encoded, as well as the order in which they appear in the output.

encoding.csv.quote.label: Encoding CSV Quote
encoding.csv.quote.hint: The quote character to use when writing CSV.

encoding.csv.quote_style.label: Encoding CSV Quote Style
encoding.csv.quote_style.hint: The quoting style to use when writing CSV data.

encoding.except_fields.label: Encoding Except Fields
encoding.except_fields.hint: List of fields that are excluded from the encoded event.

encoding.json.pretty.label: Encoding Json Pretty
encoding.json.pretty.hint: Whether to use pretty JSON formatting.

encoding.json.metric_tag_values.label: Encoding Metric Tag Values
encoding.json.metric_tag_values.hint: Controls how metric tag values are encoded.

encoding.text.metric_tag_values.label: Encoding Metric Tag Values
encoding.text.metric_tag_values.hint: Controls how metric tag values are encoded.

encoding.only_fields.label: Encoding Only Fields
encoding.only_fields.hint: List of fields that are included in the encoded event.

encoding.protobuf.desc_file.label: Encoding Protobuf Desc File
encoding.protobuf.desc_file.hint: The path to the protobuf descriptor set file.

encoding.protobuf.message_type.label: Encoding Protobuf Message Type
encoding.protobuf.message_type.hint: The name of the message type to use for serializing.

framing.character_delimited.delimiter.label: Framing Character Delimited Delimiter
framing.character_delimited.delimiter.hint: The character that delimits byte sequences.

framing.character_delimited.max_length.label: Framing Character Delimited Max Length
framing.character_delimited.max_length.hint: The maximum length of the byte buffer. This length does not include the trailing delimiter.

framing.length_delimited.length_field_is.label: Framing Length Delimited Length Field is Big Endian
framing.length_delimited.length_field_is.hint: Length field byte order (little or big endian).

framing.length_delimited.length_field_le.label: Framing Length Delimited Length Field Length
framing.length_delimited.length_field_le.hint: Number of bytes representing the field length.

framing.length_delimited.length_field_of.label: Framing Length Delimited Length Field Offset
framing.length_delimited.length_field_of.hint: Number of bytes in the header before the length field.

framing.newline_delimited.max_length.label: Framing Newline Delimited Max Length
framing.newline_delimited.max_length.hint: The maximum length of the byte buffer.

method.label: Method
method.hint: Specifies the method of the HTTP request.

payload_prefix.label: Payload Prefix
payload_prefix.hint: A string to prefix the payload with.

payload_suffix.label: Payload Suffix
payload_suffix.hint: A string to suffix the payload with.

proxy.http.label: Proxy HTTP
proxy.http.hint: Proxy endpoint to use when proxying HTTP traffic.

proxy.https.label: Proxy HTTPS
proxy.https.hint: Proxy endpoint to use when proxying HTTPS traffic.

proxy.no_proxy.label: Proxy No Proxy
proxy.no_proxy.hint: A list of hosts to avoid proxying.
